body.statement: Close the remaining factor-two logarithmic elbow isolated in \(\mathrm{oeq:compatible\text{-}prefix\text{-}approximation}\).  Refine the computable truncated-prefix upper functions and every-depth paired lower functions in \(\mathrm{prop:finite\text{-}history\text{-}envelopes}\) into matching evaluable functions \(r(n,T,c)\) and \(\ell(n,T,c)\) on that elbow, with a total finite-data estimator and a calibrated honest connected interval.  Splice the result with \(\mathrm{prop:endpoint\text{-}reduction}\) and \(\mathrm{thm:long\text{-}history\text{-}frontier}\) to obtain the all-sample transition, including saturation and shrinking \(c\), and then give necessary and sufficient consistency and oracle-order-penalty conditions along arbitrary sequences \((T_n,c_n)\).  State finite computational cost, and keep both converses on the original fixed-\(n\) iid experiment over the same class \(\mathcal P_T\).

obligation.what_is_open: Matching evaluable risk and honest-length functions on the intermediate factor-two logarithmic elbow, and therefore necessary and sufficient consistency and oracle-penalty conditions for arbitrary sequences.
obligation.obstruction: The theorem depends on the unresolved compatible-prefix approximation and testing dual.  The proved upper and lower finite optimizations match at zero shift and beyond the birthday-collision depth but need not coincide between those endpoints.
obligation.attempted: Combined empirical truncated trees, the dimension-free centered gradient, natural-mean bias control, Bernoulli floors, and complementary-context mixtures over every admissible depth; the resulting bracket is explicit but not sharp in the elbow.
obligation.partial_result:
The proved finite-sample bracket is Proposition~\ref{prop:finite-history-envelopes}.  At \(c=0\), \(\mathrm{prop:endpoint\text{-}reduction}\) gives \(R(n,T,0)\asymp n^{-1}\) and \(L(n,T,0)\asymp n^{-1/2}\) for every \(T\).  If \(T\geq2k_n\), \(\mathrm{thm:long\text{-}history\text{-}frontier}\) gives
\[
R(n,T,c)\asymp\min\{1,n^{-1}+c^2\},
\qquad
L(n,T,c)\asymp\min\{1,n^{-1/2}+c\}.
\]
In that long-history regime and along \(n\to\infty\), consistency is equivalent to \(c_n\to0\).  Using \(\mathrm{prop:oracle\text{-}benchmark}\), unknown and oracle orders agree exactly when \(c_n=O(n^{-1/2})\); their risk and length ratios have orders \(1+nc_n^2\) and \(1+\sqrt n c_n\), respectively.  The remaining intermediate-depth bounds are explicit and computable but not known to match.

body.justification: The endpoints and a computable all-domain bracket are proved; the question now asks only for the matching interpolation and its sequence consequences.
body.gap: Necessary and sufficient all-sequence consistency and oracle-penalty conditions remain unavailable because the intermediate upper and lower optimizations need not coincide.
body.consumer: The completed result would determine precisely when increasing unrestricted history complexity changes attainable precision.
